t: 3Rd Anniversary Of Local Sino-Japanese Hostilities August 13 - Observance

pages.en:
CONFIDENTIAL
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE S.M.P. REGISTRY 397 13/8/40）
Special Branch, S.M.P.
August 9, 1940.

3rd Anniversary of local Sino-Japanese hostilities
August 13 - observance

Information at present is to the effect that
the local Chinese community will refrain from conducting
any movement in commemoration of the anniversary of
August 13 in view of the unsettled situation prevailing
locally. Enquiries among public bodies, schools, and
refugee camps ascertain that they will not hold any
meetings or undertake any other form of activity. The
majority of the theatres and amusement resorts including
the Roof Gardens of the four Department Stores on
Nanking Road intend closing on August 13 as they have
done in previous years, while factories and commercial
concerns will carry on as usual.

It is learned that supporters of the Kuomintang
and other pro-National Government elements will observe
the anniversary by publishing articles of a national
salvation nature in the Chinese Press. Visits may be
made to the "Lone Battalion" on that day.

The pro-Japanese organisations which include
the Great People's Society, 22 Columbia Road and other
Japanese sponsored official organs with offices in
Nantao, Chapei and Pootung, have not as yet received
any instructions for commemorating the anniversary.

当地中日敌对行动三周年
8月13日 – 纪念活动

目前获悉的消息表明，鉴于当地局势动荡，本地华人社团将 refrain from（避免）举行任何纪念“八一三”周年的活动。经向各公共团体、学校及难民营查询，证实它们不会举行任何集会或开展其他形式的活动。包括南京路四大百货公司屋顶花园在内的大多数戏院和娱乐场所，打算像往年一样在8月13日停业，而工厂和商号则将照常运营。

据悉，国民党支持者及其他拥护国民政府的分子将在中文报刊上发表救国性质的文章，以此方式纪念该周年纪念日。当日可能会有人前往探访“孤军”。

亲日组织，包括位于哥伦比亚路22号的“大民会”以及其他由日本资助、在南市、闸北和浦东设有办事处的官方机构，迄今尚未收到关于纪念该周年纪念日的任何指示。
